title: Araxxor Tweaks & Poll 82 Updates
quote: Before we move on, we'd like to confirm that the drop rates for Araxxor's uniques on the OSRS Wiki are accurate! The Araxyte Fang has a drop rate of 1 in 600, while Noxious Halberd pieces drop at a rate of 1 in 200. They use a similar system to the Abyssal Bludgeon to prevent you from obtaining any duplicate pieces until you've completed a full weapon. Plus, don't think we forgot... Pet drop rate! Nid, the little cutie, has a 1 in 3,000 chance, increased to 1 in 1,500 if you use the 'Destroy' option.

title: New Slayer Boss - The Araxyte
quote: Our final untradeable is the Jar of Venom – which might seem a bit odd, because all our other ‘Jar’ items have been tradeable. This puts them in a weird spot of being rare ‘flex’ cosmetics that you can purchase for a relatively inconsequential price – and for the Jar of Venom, we want to try something a bit more exclusive.

title: Araxxor CAs, Poll 82 Updates & More!
quote: We’ve also heard your frustrations regarding RNG resets in speedrun tasks, so this time we’re trying something new. Our new approach encourages steady, repeated quick kills within a set time frame, rather than relying on a single lucky attempt. For example, instead of "Kill Araxxor in X minutes" which was the previous approach, we're now going with "Kill Araxxor 4 times in 10:00". This way, RNG balances out over multiple kills.

title: Varlamore Tweaks & Drop Rates
quote: In a move to enhance your looting experience, we've also implemented a duplication protection system. This means you won't receive duplicate items from a set until you've completed the set, ensuring a smoother progression towards collecting all set pieces.

title: Undead Pirates, Colosseum Changes & more!
quote: Additionally, a clarification from last week's post: we made an error in our post last week with regards to the Perilous Moon drop rates. In it, we stated that each boss slain gave a 1/56 chance of obtaining its respective armour set, totalling a 3/56 (or ~1/18.67) chance for a unique. That much is correct! What's not correct is our statement that defeating all three bosses would provide an additional 1/56 roll at any item, for a total of 1/14. This is not the case and has never been the case, we just got some wires crossed with our post last week and can only apologise for that!
notes: This is a correction made by Jagex after posting incorrect rates in a previous news post.

None of your tradeable items will carry over (with more checks in place to prevent loopholes from last time), nor will any untradeable items that can be converted into tradeable items (e.g. Barrows gloves for coins or God books for pages). Instead, you'll keep all of your Skills progression and be given 12 hours of protection on world 345 which you can use to get yourself geared up without interruption, if you'd like to carry on playing on the permanent Deadman world.
